call_input.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit the supplied poster, changing only its title typography and title layout. Preserve the dark photographic garden scene, exact existing composition and 2:3 portrait canvas. Keep the connected plants, blossoms, tree canopy, earth path, natural depth, camera position, cropping, upper-left illumination, petal texture and leaf surfaces unchanged.

The current title is too small and isolated at the bottom. Replace that entire existing title with a substantially larger two-line typographic group nested into the plant-framed foreground opening of the path. The path's widening near entrance must organize the title: center both lines on the path's central axis, with the upper line closer to the narrower receding section and the larger lower line across the broad near aperture. The type and opening should be perceived together at first glance.

The sole printed title remains exactly:
밤에 피는 정원

Wrap at the word boundary before the final word. Set the first two words on the upper line, retaining a clearly visible normal word space between them. Set the final word on the lower line. The two lines together are one occurrence of the complete title. Preserve every Korean syllable; do not repeat any word elsewhere.

Concrete optical layout on the existing canvas: the upper line is centered at approximately 50% of canvas width, starts at approximately 69% of canvas height, and occupies roughly 54% of canvas width. Its visible Korean letter height is approximately 9% of canvas height. The lower line is centered on the same path axis, begins near 81% of canvas height, occupies roughly 60% of canvas width, and has a visible Korean letter height of approximately 15% of canvas height. Use close, deliberate line grouping with a comfortable clear gap; leave at least 4% of canvas height below the lower line. The larger lower word should act as the near entry threshold, not as a small caption. Use substantial warm ivory Korean serif strokes related to the source lettering, with readable counters and consistent optical spacing. Keep all letters crisp and all word boundaries unmistakable.

Place typography on top of the image as flat printed type. No plant may occlude any letter; preserve visible contrast against the dark path and adjacent shadowed leaves. Do not move, remove or invent plants to make a blank panel. Do not add a box, band, frame, glow, shadow, embossing, lettering texture or additional decorative effect. Remove all traces of the previous single-line title. Keep the remaining photographic scene as close to the source as possible.

Print no additional copy, labels, symbols, quotation marks, dates, numbers, metadata, logo, signature or watermark. One single flat 2:3 poster, no mockup or panels.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
